text: High transaction costs in centralized payment systems make micro-payments for small tasks uneconomic, whereas blockchain ledgers process tiny transfers efficiently and thereby widen the pool of contributors willing to do micro-tasks.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Artificial Intelligence The Final Frontier (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5095633
abstract: High transaction costs in centralized models often preclude micro-payments for smaller tasks. In contrast, blockchain-based ledgers can process tiny financial transfers efficiently, facilitating fair compensation for incremental work and expanding the pool of potential contributors

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: ledger transaction fees are low enough to support micro-payments
